packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates automatically once required checks pass. Digest updates aren't merged automatically: the same version with new content means a moved tag, a rebuilt image or a new commit on a tracked branch, none of which went through a release

Wait a day after a release before raising the update. Overrides the 3 days config:best-practices sets for npm. Pins, replacements, lock file maintenance and other update types without a new release are left out, as security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm does
Actions are pinned by .github/workflows/actions.lock, so keep readable tags; reusable workflows and images are not in the lockfile and stay digest-pinned, except actions-fyi's
actions-fyi reusable workflows are called by tag: the org blocks updating and deleting tags, and the OpenBao and Octo STS trust policies bind the tag ref, which a commit SHA doesn't match
zizmor-action only installs the zizmor versions it ships a lock for, so update both together
zizmor 1.32.0 can't parse an actions.lock without dependencies: https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2542
Major updates wait for a human
Updates in workflows also get the workflows label
